second_method.method: independent count of question blocks on the renders of pdf 28-31 (8 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 1 = 28) and of answer-side keys 1-28 (pdf 106-107); the BLUE PRINT total 8+7+3 = 18 disagrees (FINDING, addendum §8)

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-28 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-8, II 9-12, III 13-16, IV 17-20, V 21-24, VI 25-27, VII 28); answer side keys 1-28 in order. BLUE PRINT total 18 (8/7/3) disagrees with the audited 28 -> quota_table 'inconsistent', independent count as second method (addendum §8; finding, not a stop). Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 28.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 28 (heading, LO 7, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 29 (q4-11) 30 (q12-20) 31 (q21-28). A side 'Key Answers: 6. Variety of Food' pdf 106 (keys 1-25), pdf 107 (26-28). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides). MCQ keys 1-6 print a trailing letter copy ('B.') before the Kannada option word — kept in answer_as_printed only.

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-8; s2 II match q9-12 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III 'Give two examples' q13-16 -> vsa (list keys); s4 IV relationship q17-20 (printed blank -> fill, ':'/': :' spacing kept); s5 V fill q21-24; s6 VI q25-27; s7 VII q28. Types by key form: sa q25 (three labelled lines, 3 steps), vsa q26-27 (one sentence each), la q28 (five sentences, one paragraph).

MARKS (R-E9): s1 '8X1=8' -> 1; s2 '4 X 1=4' -> 1; s4 '4 X 1=4' -> 1; s5 '4x1=4' -> 1; s6 '3 X 2=6' -> 2; s3 '1x4=4' (N=1 over 4 printed) -> null; s7 '1 X 3=3' (1 q) -> null, M=3 is not the smaller factor (R-E9 as written).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. LO (R-E10): lesson LO 7, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

KEYS: MCQ letter+text, all agree. Match: key 9 printed glued 'II 9Toordal' (vs column B 'Toor Dal'), key 10 'Corn-Wheat' (vs 'Corn/Wheat') flagged; key 11 'Rice' for row 'Rice' (column B also prints 'Rice') stored as printed, unflagged. Analogy keys q18 'Corn-Worm-Salt', q19 'Animal blood' kept verbatim. Stray '?' and 'ʻ' glyph lines from the Kannada layer (q1, q8) dropped.
Source wording kept: 'Togari' (q2 B), 'Prophylaxis', 'Mouthfeel', 'Palav', 'vegetarian, carnivorous and omnivorous.Tiger' (q25), key 'Jowar ,Potato'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-06-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
